line: An automation built in n8n can already say "done" — and still go do the exact same thing again.
Here's why: it waits for the whole thing to finish, and only then replies.
If it takes more than a few seconds, it looks like the message never arrived — and gets sent again.
It has no memory of ever seeing that one. It just runs the entire automation again, real actions included.
That's how one real event turns into two real emails, or two real charges — from a system that never once said it failed.
The fix: reply right away, then do the real work after — nothing ever sits long enough to be sent twice.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
